title: OID-See Findings Delta Export Schema
description: Schema for the findings delta (drift) report produced by findings_diff.compare_findings / compare_findings.py. Delta entries are derived artefacts computed by comparing two findings exports. This schema does not govern scanner scoring or finding semantics.

riskScore.description: Risk score from 0 to 100, or null when the finding did not exist in that scan.

subjectKey.description: Stable subject key used to match the same app across scans. Derived from servicePrincipalId → appId → findingId in priority order.

findingId.description: Canonical finding ID for this delta entry: the current findingId if available, otherwise the previous findingId.

previousFindingId.description: Finding ID from the previous scan. Set only when the finding ID changed between scans (i.e. reason codes changed), otherwise null.

currentFindingId.description: Finding ID from the current scan. Set only when the finding ID changed between scans (i.e. reason codes changed), otherwise null.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the app or service principal.

servicePrincipalId.description: Object ID of the enterprise application (service principal), if available.

status.description: Classification of how the finding changed between scans.

previousRiskScore.description: Risk score from the previous scan, or null for new findings.

currentRiskScore.description: Risk score from the current scan, or null for resolved findings.

previousRiskLevel.description: Risk level from the previous scan, or null for new findings.

currentRiskLevel.description: Risk level from the current scan, or null for resolved findings.

previousReasonCodes.description: Reason codes from the previous scan. Empty array for new findings.

currentReasonCodes.description: Reason codes from the current scan. Empty array for resolved findings.

addedReasonCodes.description: Reason codes present in the current scan but not the previous scan.

removedReasonCodes.description: Reason codes present in the previous scan but not the current scan.

unchangedReasonCodes.description: Reason codes present in both scans.

previousConfidence.description: Confidence level from the previous scan, or null for new findings.

currentConfidence.description: Confidence level from the current scan, or null for resolved findings.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what changed between scans for this subject.

analystAction.description: Suggested analyst action for this delta entry. Empty string for unchanged findings.
